replies.author: @RealLifeExplorerUS
replies.text: Thank you for pointing out this important distinction!! 😊 Healthcare in Spain isn't truly free—it’s funded through taxes and social security contributions from workers and employers. What makes the system special is that people can access essential healthcare without having to pay the full cost at the time of treatment.
